name: Ismark Kolyanovich
title: Son of the Burgomaster
summary: The late burgomaster's son, a capable swordsman the village calls 'the Lesser'. He wants his father buried and his sister Ireena taken somewhere the devil can't reach.

guest_build.note: His own block, built to keep up with Ezmerelda (docs/story/ismark_companion.md): a greatsword in three cuts a turn, a crossbow while foes close, Parry.
